title: Techno-economic analysis and life cycle assessment for the rapid carbonation of beer
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6FB00143B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Alexandra B. Jean, Jordan Funkhouser, Robert C. Brown
The bulk gas-to-liquid (BGAL) approach reduced the operating costs of beer carbonation by 40%, energy demand by 99%, and global warming potential by 98%. Thus, the BGAL system offers economic and environmental benefits in a micro-brewery setting.
